描述_EN: in the song (960-1279) and subsequent dynasties, chinese scholars systematically studied ritual objects from antiquity. the pattern on this lidded cup is in imitation of patterns found on archaic bronzes. that scholarly interest led to many articles being made 'in the ancient style'.
描述_ZN: 在宋朝（960-1279）及以后的朝代中，中国学者系统地研究了古代的祭祀用品。 这个盖子上的图案是模仿古代青铜器上的图案。 这种学术兴趣导致了许多 "古代风格 "的物品被制作出来。
